sections.title: Knowledge is Power
sections.body: The Kenya AI Compute Resource Library is designed to provide our diverse stakeholders with exactly the level of detail they need. From high-level 'Executive Summaries' for quick review to 50-page 'Technical Design Documents' for systems architects, we believe that transparency is the best way to build a lasting ecosystem. Our documents are categorized into public resources (available for immediate download) and restricted Data Room assets (available for verified partners under NDA). We regularly update our library with new monthly progress reports, updated financial simulations, and fresh research on the global AI market. Use this hub to perform your own analysis and see why we are the leading compute infrastructure asset in the region. Additional context: the project follows a clear rollout roadmap that aligns low-cost energy, infrastructure reliability, and flexible deployment models.
